landing.title: Make your CV, LinkedIn and website tell one strong story
landing.subtitle: Porichoy checks all three in one scan, shows the exact line behind every problem, and rewrites weak sections in your own voice. In English or Bangla.

stats.label: of findings backed by a quote

landing.previewFinding: Headline is only a job title

steps.title: Add your profile
steps.body: Paste your website link, upload your CV and your LinkedIn PDF export. No passwords, ever.

steps.title: Agents check it
steps.body: Gemini agents check each source, then compare all three for contradictions.

steps.title: Approve the fixes
steps.body: Each rewrite passes an independent verifier. You approve it, copy it and paste it.

features.title: Evidence for every finding
features.body: Every problem links to the exact quote in your CV, profile or site. If the quote isn't there, the finding is dropped.

features.title: A second AI checks every rewrite
features.body: A separate model rejects any rewrite that invents clients, numbers or dates.

features.title: Scores you can explain
features.body: Scores come from fixed, published rules, so the same content always gets the same score.

features.title: Contradictions flagged
features.body: Different job titles or dates across your sources are flagged, with a suggested fix.

features.title: Match a job post
features.body: Paste a job post to see your match score, your skill gaps and a tailored headline.

features.title: Safe with LinkedIn
features.body: We never log in, scrape or type on LinkedIn for you. You stay in control of every edit.

landing.ctaBody: It takes about ten minutes. Your files are deleted after 30 days.
